Subject: Post-demo cost projection & next steps (Astrum Health)

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the next steps I promised on pricing and unit economics so you can share with the finance team. I pulled together an initial cost projection based on the volumes you quoted on the call (see attached spreadsheet). Key assumptions I used:

- Active user base: 12k monthly active users (MAU) with 2.4M prompt tokens/month and 6.8M completion tokens/month (9.2M total tokens/month).
- Peak concurrency window: 18:00-22:00 PT; average latency SLO requirement: <= 250ms p95.
- Model profile: open-tuned LlamaX-13B equivalent; recommended quantization profile: q4_0 for production.
- Required retention/audit logs: 90 days (adds ~6% to token storage egress in Dedicated config).

I attached two artifacts: a per-month cost model (astrum_redwood_cost_model_v2.xlsx) and a compact pricing calc (redwood_pricing_calc.csv) that shows per-1M-token unit costs under multiple commitment tiers. Highlights:

- Base hosted unit cost (no commit): ~$28 / 1M tokens.
- 3-month committed tier (Reserved): ~$18 / 1M tokens with 30% discount on long-running workloads (>500k tokens/day).
- Recommended starting target (to hit your budget): $10k - $15k/month would require ~350M - 500M tokens/month under a Reserved plan and some batching+cache settings.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the monthly token range (low/expected/high) for Q2? The attached sheet includes Low/Med/High slots.
2) Any constraints on procurement timing or preferred billing cadence (monthly vs annual)?
3) If interested, we can run a 2-week pilot on a Dedicated pool to measure real-world latency/cost and generate an invoice-ready estimate.

I'll wait on the confirmed volumes and procurement window, then Marissa and I will update the estimate and route for approvals.

Thanks —

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — very helpful summary. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Volumes: our internal estimate (pre-launch) is 50M tokens/mo (low), 120M tokens/mo (expected), 420M tokens/mo (peak). These include user prompts + model responses.
- Budget: procurement has signaled a target of ~$25k/month for initial 6 months, but we could scale to $60k/mo if SLA and latency targets are demonstrably met.
- Billing: prefer quarterly billing if possible. Procurement also asks for a 30-day cancellation window on any committed capacity trial.

Can you update the model with the three volume tiers? Also want a line item showing estimated total cost for 1) hosted API with no commit, 2) reserved Dedicated capacity (monthly commit), and 3) Dedicated pilot (2-week) with pro-rated invoice.

Lena

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks for the numbers — they line up well with the ranges I modeled. I updated the attached workbook (astrum_redwood_cost_model_v2.xlsx) to include Low / Expected / Peak rows and added the three billing scenarios you requested. Summary below (all $ values approximate, monthly):

- Scenario A — Hosted (no commit):
  - Low (50M tokens): $1,400 / month (~$28 / 1M tokens)
  - Expected (120M tokens): $3,360 / month (~$28 / 1M tokens)
  - Peak (420M tokens): $11,760 / month (~$28 / 1M tokens)

- Scenario B — Reserved Dedicated (monthly commit, 3-month min pricing example):
  - Low (50M): $900 / month (~$18 / 1M tokens)
  - Expected (120M): $2,160 / month (~$18 / 1M tokens)
  - Peak (420M): $7,560 / month (~$18 / 1M tokens)

- Scenario C — Dedicated pilot (2-week pro-rated estimate; includes reserved overhead + onboarding):
  - Pilot pro-rated: $3,000 - $5,500 (depending on required peak headroom and observability retention)

Unit economics / notes:
- Target unit price to meet procurement's $25k/mo goal: ~ $60 / 1M tokens for a 420M token month would be ~$25k — that implies a blended reserved+hosted mix or a large commitment discount.
- We assume typical batching and prefix caching will reduce billable token volume by ~8-12%; I modeled 10% improvement in the Expected row.
- SLA addendum and audit log storage increase fixed costs by an estimated +6% in Dedicated scenarios (see SLA_addendum_draft.pdf).

Attachments updated:
- astrum_redwood_cost_model_v2.xlsx (updated with Low/Expected/Peak and pro-rated pilot)
- redwood_pricing_calc.csv (shows per-1M token math, discount tiers)
- SLA_addendum_draft.pdf (outlines retention & audit cost impacts)

Next suggested steps:
1) If you want the most accurate invoice estimate, Marissa can authorize a quick capacity reservation for a 2-week pilot and we will run a controlled load test to produce exact p95 latency and final cost.
2) If procurement is comfortable with the Reserved numbers, we can draft a short-term commitment (3 months) and show quarterly billing options and cancellation terms.

Please confirm which scenario you'd like us to proceed with and any procurement constraints; we'll convert to an invoice-ready quote.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
